description: Scroll-driven animations (animation-timeline: scroll()) as Chromium 153 runs them: each scroller's offset over its maximum drives background colour, opacity and transform animations (filled both ways); ranges of lengths (0 96px) and calc(100% - 96px) 100% resolved against the maximum offset; a delay and two alternating iterations converted to proportions of the range; scroll(nearest) from a sticky child; the x axis and the inline axis of a right-to-left scroller (from its right-hand origin); an inactive timeline (no overflow: no effect); content that grows changes the range. Wheel turns, programmatic scrolling (scrollTop, scrollLeft past the end) and a growing scroll range; animation-duration read back from the inline style and getComputedStyle (auto, a list with auto, auto from the stylesheet on a scroll timeline), before and after a script style write, which keeps a scroll-driven auto duration running
